tips.text: Buy the 500-standing Drex Core, Trux Gyro and Drimper Bracket for the other three slots; only the Model counts for Mastery.
Buy the Training and Shelter Debt-Bonds from Ticker for credits instead of running bounties.
Level the Moa on Sedna Hydron Defense with a booster; it reaches rank 15 in two rounds.
Fit vitality, armour and shield mods and an Orokin Reactor before leveling, and fight Grineer for the best affinity.
Trade a Moa in at Legs only after its Mastery is banked; a max-rank or gilded one returns 1,800 to 2,400 standing.
Reach Doer before building anything; the usual regret is rushing a Moa you cannot yet gild.
